one_tail_fox: an ORIGINAL one-tailed young fox spirit, the humblest member of the fox-spirit tribe: a small nimble FOX CREATURE with a slightly oversized head, big curious amber eyes, narrow expressive muzzle, large pointed ears and ONE single fluffy tail curling upward like a brush stroke. Russet-orange fur with ivory chest and tail tip. Wears only a tiny faded indigo hemp scarf knotted at the neck and a small aged brass bell. One front paw holds up a small flickering jade-white foxfire wisp; mischievous half-smile, eager apprentice-mage pose.
three_tail_fox: an ORIGINAL three-tailed adolescent fox spirit, a little taller and more poised than a one-tailed kit: a slender FOX CREATURE standing upright on hind legs, THREE distinct russet tails with ivory tips fanned behind, each tip holding a tiny jade foxfire spark. Wears a short faded indigo cape pinned with a small brass clasp. Holds a short bamboo wand with a pale ochre tassel pointed forward; sly focused eyes, one ear cocked.
five_tail_fox: an ORIGINAL five-tailed seasoned fox hunter-mage: a lean wiry FOX CREATURE with a notched left ear and a confident hunter's grin, FIVE long russet-and-ivory tails spread in a crescent fan. A knotted cord of dull jade beads wound around one foreleg; three small jade foxfire flames orbit its raised paw. Weathered ink-indigo sash, battle-ready crouch that reads as quick and dangerous.
fox_shaman: an ORIGINAL fox-spirit shaman (mudang): an upright FOX CREATURE with three tails, wearing a muted brick-red and ink-indigo shaman over-robe with wide sleeves. One paw shakes a brass spirit-bell rod with a cluster of small bells, the other holds a folded fan trailing five muted ribbon streamers. Half-closed trance eyes and a knowing smile; a thin curl of dusky violet curse-smoke rises from the bells.
fox_spirit_elder: an ORIGINAL ancient fox elder, keeper of the tribe's oldest illusions: a stooped but dignified FOX CREATURE with a white-frosted muzzle, long drooping eyebrow fur and wise squinting eyes, NINE long silver-ivory tails billowing behind like a layered cloud. Leans on a gnarled pine staff from which hangs a small jade foxfire in a woven cord. Simple faded indigo robe with a worn brass clasp.
spring_gumiho: an ORIGINAL spring fox spirit who heals the season's first sprouts: a cheerful upright FOX CREATURE with four soft ivory-and-russet tails, a small wreath of pale pink azalea blossoms between its ears, carrying a little woven herb basket on one arm. Other paw opened outward in a gentle sheltering gesture releasing a few drifting petals. Pale indigo short jacket with an ochre knot.
summer_gumiho: an ORIGINAL summer fox spirit who slows invaders with cool river air: a relaxed upright FOX CREATURE with four tails, wearing a round woven straw sun hat tied with a tide-blue ribbon, holding open a large round hand fan painted with simple wave lines. Stands with sleeves spread protectively, a faint cool breeze curling around its feet. Light ivory hemp summer clothes.
ice_gumiho: an ORIGINAL frost fox spirit: an elegant upright FOX CREATURE with pale silver-white fur, SEVEN tails whose tips fade into frost-blue ice crystals. Holds up a slender icicle-crystal wand; a small spiral of frost motes circles it. Composed cool gaze. Ink-indigo cloth wrap with a tiny frost-blue knot and aged brass charm.
thunder_gumiho: an ORIGINAL thunder fox spirit: a bristling energetic upright FOX CREATURE with EIGHT spiky tails crackling with small pale-gold sparks. Beats a small bronze hand drum with a knobbed stick, the drum's rim edged with zigzag bronze fringe. Fur standing on end, fierce grin. Short ink-indigo vest bound with a rope belt.
fox_warrior: an ORIGINAL fox warrior born of a dokkaebi alliance: a sturdy broad-shouldered upright FOX CREATURE with two thick tails, wearing pieces of baked-clay dokkaebi armor and a rope belt with a brass bell. Wields a heavy wooden club-staff wrapped in brick-red cord with bronze bands, raised mid double-strike. Warm ember glints in its eyes, fearless grin.
gumiho_queen: an ORIGINAL nine-tailed fox matriarch: a regal tall upright FOX CREATURE with NINE long ivory tails arranged in a sweeping royal fan, wearing a small jade-and-brass ceremonial headpiece (not a western crown) and a long ink-indigo robe with dusky mulberry lining and hanging brass norigae tassels. Holds a large jade foxfire orb at chest height; calm commanding gaze.
gumiho_goddess: an ORIGINAL divine fox goddess who blesses her whole tribe: a serene upright FOX CREATURE with NINE luminous ivory tails spread evenly like a halo fan behind her, soft ivory-gold light along the tail edges. Wears a pale ceremonial robe with long flowing cloud sleeves and a sun-brass sash. Both forepaws opened wide in a protective blessing; gentle closed-eye smile.
gumiho_archmage: an ORIGINAL fox archmage scholar of forbidden curses: an upright FOX CREATURE with SIX tails, small round brass spectacles on the muzzle, deep ink-indigo scholar robe with wide sleeves. Holds a thick thread-bound talisman book open in one paw and a calligraphy brush in the other, the brush trailing abstract glowing jade strokes (shapes only, no readable letters).
celestial_fairy: an ORIGINAL celestial fox maiden (seonnyeo), bond of the fox tribe and the mountain spirits: a graceful FOX CREATURE floating slightly above the ground, wrapped in a pale cloud-thread feather robe whose long sash drifts in an arc, THREE soft ivory tails. Holds a small pine sprig with a jade dew drop; arms opened to share strength with allies. Serene and gentle.
gumiho_demon: an ORIGINAL fallen nine-tailed fox deity of fear: a large intimidating but not gory FOX CREATURE with ink-black fur, dusky violet eyes, NINE tails shaped like dark curling flames tipped with muted violet foxfire. A cracked bronze ritual mask pushed up onto its brow, tattered ink-indigo mantle. Low stalking stance, menacing grin; brave-game villain, never horror.
thunder_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL thunder dokkaebi: a wiry long-armed goblin folk spirit (clearly nonhuman, not a horned boy) with slate-blue clay skin, two short roof-tile horns crackling with tiny pale-gold sparks and wild hair standing on end. Swings a bronze-banded wooden club trailing a small zigzag of pale-gold light; gleeful toothy grin, mid-swing stance.
ice_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL frost dokkaebi: a stout round goblin folk spirit with pale grey-blue clay skin, frost-rimed roof-tile horns and a thick quilted hemp coat. Carries a heavy wooden club whose head is encased in a clear block of ice; puffs a small frosty breath, stubborn squat stance.
healer_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL healer dokkaebi: a round-bellied gentle goblin folk spirit with warm ochre clay skin, small rounded horns, a medicine gourd hanging from a rope belt and a cloth bundle of herbs on its back. Arms opened wide in a sheltering pose, one palm glowing with a soft jade healing light; kind wrinkled smile.
dokkaebi_captain: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi captain: a broad heavy goblin folk spirit with brick-red clay skin, one horn chipped off, wearing a battered iron-studded hemp vest and a small triangular war pennant strapped to its back. Raises a heavy iron-banded club while shouting a rallying roar; wide commanding stance.
dokkaebi_bomber: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi bomber: a hunched gleeful goblin folk spirit with dusky clay skin and stubby horns, a satchel full of round clay fire-pots on its hip. Winds up to throw one fire-pot with a sputtering pale-gold fuse spark; overhand throwing pose that reads as ranged.
dokkaebi_duelist: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi duelist: a nimble lean goblin folk spirit with charcoal-violet clay skin and swept-back horns, holding two short straight Korean-style bronze blades with red tassels, crossed in a quick double-strike stance. Tight ink-indigo wrap clothes, focused narrow eyes.
poison_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL poison dokkaebi: a hunched sly goblin folk spirit with sickly moss-green clay skin and twisted horns, a stoppered venom gourd on its hip. Its short gnarled club drips thick moss-green venom; crooked grin, sneaky forward crouch.
shadow_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL shadow dokkaebi: a slim ink-black goblin folk spirit whose legs fade into its own dark shadow wisps, small ember-orange eyes and thin curved horns. Holds a short club low in an evasive sidestep; half-there, slippery silhouette with clear edges.
shield_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL shield dokkaebi: a very stout heavy goblin folk spirit with warm clay skin and thick horns, bracing behind a big round wooden shield rimmed in bronze and painted with a simple spiral, a short club ready in the other hand. Immovable guarding stance.
dokkaebi_shaman: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi shaman: an old stooped goblin folk spirit with a long white beard, curled horns and a necklace of wooden beads and small bones. Leans on a gnarled staff hung with blank paper talismans and a small spirit bell, a curl of dusky violet curse smoke rising from its palm.
dokkaebi_king: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi king: a big-bellied jovial goblin folk spirit with deep red clay skin, grand curled horns and a simple brass headband (not a western crown), wearing a red-lacquer robe. Lifts a large gleaming brass-banded magic club (the treasure-making bangmangi) with a booming laugh.
storm_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL storm dokkaebi: a wild-haired goblin folk spirit riding a small swirling grey cloud, clay-blue skin and sharp horns, striking a bronze gong with a mallet so small pale-gold lightning ribbons spread sideways in a row.
gold_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL golden dokkaebi: a chubby cheerful goblin folk spirit with ochre clay skin, strings of brass coins with square holes draped around its neck and belt. Shakes a golden-brass magic club from which a few coins tumble out; generous open-armed stance.
fire_dokkaebi_king: an ORIGINAL fire dokkaebi king: a towering heavy goblin folk spirit with dark basalt skin cracked by glowing ember seams, horns like burning roof tiles, a scorched red-lacquer robe. Hefts a massive club wreathed in contained ember flames; fierce regal roar.
black_dragon_dokkaebi: an ORIGINAL black-dragon dokkaebi: a powerful goblin folk spirit wearing black Korean-dragon scale armor pieces (whiskered wingless serpent dragon motif, no western wings), dark clay skin and long swept horns. Wields a club carved as a coiling dragon, faint dusky violet aura.
dokkaebi_general: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi general: an armored heavy goblin folk spirit in Joseon-style studded cloth armor (dujeong-gap) with horn fittings on a round iron helmet, a huge iron-banded club over the shoulder and a tattered command banner behind. Veteran scarred face, unshakable stance.
dokkaebi_god_king: an ORIGINAL dokkaebi god-king: a colossal serene ancient goblin deity with a great round belly, long ivory beard and grand weathered horns, a sun-brass ring halo behind the head. Holds an enormous brass magic club aloft in blessing while the other hand is opened to protect allies.
ghost_hunter: an ORIGINAL underworld ghost hunter: a small chibi spirit in a tapering ink-black hunter's robe and a broad black horsehair gat, pale mask-like face with calm eyes. Draws back a short peach-wood exorcist bow whose arrow is a rolled spirit-paper talisman trailing pale jade smoke; a small paper lantern hangs from the belt. Reads as ranged. No firearms.
venom_warrior: an ORIGINAL underworld venom warrior: a gaunt spirit swordsman in a tapering dusky ink robe with a broad gat pulled low, a pale green serpent coiled around one arm. Holds a short curved blade dripping moss-green venom; low coiled stance like a striking snake.
abyss_mage: an ORIGINAL underworld abyss mage: a hunched robed spirit with a broad tattered gat, face hidden in shadow except two pale jade eyes, holding a paper lantern whose light is a swirl of dusky violet curse smoke. Long sleeves drip ink-like wisps; ominous but not gory.
skeleton_knight: an ORIGINAL underworld bone warrior: a sturdy skeletal guardian wearing weathered ink-cloth armor pieces and a dented bronze helmet, a pale jade flame in its eye sockets, gripping a notched iron club and a small cracked round shield. Loyal guard stance; charming not horrifying.
soul_guardian: an ORIGINAL soul guardian bridging the underworld and the mountains: a tall gentle spirit in a tapering pale ink robe and a broad gat decorated with a pine sprig, holding up a glowing paper lantern that shelters small jade soul wisps. Open protective stance.
underworld_archer: an ORIGINAL underworld archer: a small chibi spirit in a tapering ink robe and a broad gat with trailing chin ribbons, drawing a dark wooden bow nearly as tall as itself; the nocked arrow is a translucent pale jade ghost shape. Steady aiming stance that reads as ranged.
underworld_witch: an ORIGINAL underworld witch: a small wizened spirit in layered ink-and-mulberry robes and a drooping broad gat, carrying a crooked staff hung with a cluster of tiny paper lanterns, stirring a curl of dusky violet curse smoke with a bony finger. Sly smile.
hell_guard: an ORIGINAL underworld gate warden: a stout, wide chibi spirit in heavy ink-black robes and an oversized gat, both hands resting on a huge iron gate key-staff planted on the ground, a pale jade lantern chained to its belt. Taunting immovable stance.
yomra_warrior: an ORIGINAL warrior of the underworld king Yeomra: a stern chibi spirit in dark red-and-ink judge's robes over lamellar armor, a black official's hat, gripping a heavy judgment blade almost its own size and a small blank ledger tablet (no text). Grave executioner stance.
ghost_king: an ORIGINAL ghost king: a regal chibi spirit in flowing ink robes with pale jade lining, a black king's hat with jade beads, floating slightly while pale jade ghost wisps circle below. Holds a jade scepter; commanding cold smile.
spirit_summoner: an ORIGINAL spirit summoner: a small robed chibi spirit in a broad gat ringing a large bronze spirit bell, three small cute ghost wisps with round faces rising from a paper lantern at its feet. Chanting pose, sleeves swirling.
underworld_complete: an ORIGINAL underworld sovereign spirit: a calm, majestic chibi spirit in layered ink-black and deep mulberry robes, a tall gat with long jade bead strings, holding up a great paper lantern whose light forms a pale jade ring of floating souls behind it. Solemn presence through the ring and robes, not through body height.
frost_spirit: an ORIGINAL frost mountain spirit: a short stout elder spirit with mountain-like shoulders dusted in snow, a crown of frosted pine needles, beard of icicles and ochre cloth under a frost-blue shawl. Raises a staff of frozen pine wood topped with an ice crystal; cold calm gaze.
white_tiger: an ORIGINAL white tiger swordsman spirit: an upright muscular white TIGER CREATURE with black stripes (not a human in a tiger hood), a small pine-sprig headband, holding a Korean straight sword ready to lunge; pale-gold sparks along the blade. Powerful forward-charging stance.
moon_rabbit_sage: an ORIGINAL moon-rabbit sage of the mountains: a small upright white RABBIT CREATURE with long ears, a tiny pine-needle crown and an ochre scholar robe, holding a wooden mortar-pestle that gives off soft ivory-gold light. Serene helpful smile, arms open.
volcanic_warrior: an ORIGINAL volcanic mountain warrior: a hulking stone-bodied spirit with mountain-like shoulders, basalt skin cracked by glowing ember seams, a crown of charred pine, wielding a massive stone club. Furious roar, heavy stance.
celestial_healer: an ORIGINAL mountain healer spirit: a kind old spirit with a broad pine-needle crown, moss beard and bark-textured hands, in ochre robes, holding a gourd of healing spring water that glows soft ivory-gold; open sheltering arms.
deer_god: an ORIGINAL deer god of the mountains: an elegant upright DEER CREATURE with branching antlers entwined with moss and small pine sprigs, an ochre cloth drape and a brass bell, one hoof raised in a light bounding pose, soft ivory-gold glow.
bear_god: an ORIGINAL bear mountain god: a massive upright brown BEAR CREATURE with a pine-branch crown and moss on its shoulders, ochre sash, heavy paws raised to smash with a thick oak club. Protective, fierce but kind eyes.
mountain_spirit_boy: an ORIGINAL young mountain spirit attendant: a small round spirit child-creature with leaf-shaped ears, mossy hair tied up with a pine sprig, ochre cloth, carrying a little gourd of healing spring water; cheerful and open-armed. Not a human boy — clearly a nature spirit.
phoenix: an ORIGINAL Korean phoenix (bonghwang): a graceful compact firebird with a long flowing five-colored tail in muted tones, crest of feathers, perched upright with wings half open, soft ember light at the feather tips. Not a western phoenix; folk-painting inspired.
thousand_pine: an ORIGINAL thousand-year pine spirit: a gnarled living pine tree creature with a kind bark face, sweeping needle branches like arms spread to shelter allies, moss and small hanging ochre cloth charms, roots as feet.
mountain_god_complete: an ORIGINAL great mountain god: a monumental elder spirit whose shoulders are rocky peaks, wearing a crown of old pines, a long moss beard, ochre robes, accompanied by a small tiger at its feet; holds a gnarled staff and raises a hand in blessing.
sea_god_spear: an ORIGINAL sea-god spear thrower: an upright finned fish-folk creature with teal scales and a shell pauldron, hurling a long coral-tipped spear; wave-shaped stance, tide knots in its hair. Reads as ranged.
great_serpent: an ORIGINAL great house-serpent (gureongi): a huge coiled dark-scaled snake with wise amber eyes, a small straw rope tied around its neck, rearing up with coils wrapping forward. Not a dragon — no legs or horns.
sea_dragon_lord: an ORIGINAL sea dragon lord: a coiled wingless Korean water dragon with celadon-teal scales, whiskers and a pearl held in one claw, rearing from a cresting wave shape, a long bow of coral in the other claw. Majestic, not Chinese imperial.
sea_dragon_archer: an ORIGINAL young sea-dragon archer: a small upright dragon-kin creature with teal scales, fin ears and a short tail, drawing a coral bow with an ice-tipped arrow. Wave-shaped stance.
jellyfish_sorcerer: an ORIGINAL jellyfish sorcerer: a floating translucent pale-blue jellyfish creature with a round bell head and a small cute face, trailing tentacles that crackle with tiny sparks, one tentacle holding a small nacre orb.
sea_general: an ORIGINAL dragon-palace general: a stout crab-armored fish-folk warrior with a nacre shell breastplate, holding a heavy trident planted beside him, tide-knot banner at the back. Proud guard stance.
sea_witch: an ORIGINAL sea witch: a hunched octopus-folk creature with soft purple skin, eight curling arms, a shawl of kelp and nacre charms, stirring a small seashell cauldron of dusky violet curse water.
shark_warrior: an ORIGINAL shark warrior: an upright muscular SHARK CREATURE with grey-blue skin, dorsal fin, toothy grin, wearing a rope-and-shell harness and wielding a jagged coral club.
kraken_soldier: an ORIGINAL kraken soldier: a squat octopus-folk warrior with a barnacled helmet, several tentacles gripping a net and a short spear, dark ink droplets at its feet.
dragon_king_guardian: an ORIGINAL guardian of the Dragon King's palace: a massive sea-turtle-folk knight with a thick shell back, nacre armor plates and a broad round shell shield raised to protect, calm steady eyes.
tide_leviathan: an ORIGINAL deep-sea leviathan spirit: a huge round whale-like creature with a small wise face, frost-blue markings, releasing a spiral of tide water from its spout that pushes forward. Compact monumental silhouette.
sea_god_complete: an ORIGINAL sea god: a regal merfolk elder with a long white beard of sea foam, a crown of nacre shells, riding a cresting wave-shaped tail, holding a tide pearl staff aloft in blessing. Majestic and calm.
iron_mask: an ORIGINAL iron-mask guardian: a stocky mask-folk spirit whose face is a carved dark iron mask plate with a fierce expression, hemp robes and iron-studded straps, planting a heavy iron-banded club while taunting with an open-armed provoking stance.
mask_dancer: an ORIGINAL mask dancer: a lively mask-folk spirit with an original carved wooden face mask (big grin, red cheeks), long white dancing sleeves (hansam) whirling in a spiral, one leg lifted mid-spin, tassels flying.
mask_berserker: an ORIGINAL mask berserker: a wild mask-folk spirit with a cracked red-painted wooden mask and bristling hair, bare-armed, swinging two short wooden clubs in a frenzied double strike.
mask_archer: an ORIGINAL mask archer: a slender mask-folk spirit with a calm painted wooden half-mask, hemp clothes and tassels, drawing a short horn bow; the arrow tip sparks pale gold. Reads as ranged.
bongsan_maskman: an ORIGINAL Bongsan-style mask dancer: a mask-folk spirit with an original carved wooden mask of bold bumpy features (not traced from a real mask), wide-sleeved hemp costume with colored stripes, arms flung open in a provoking dance pose.
cheoyong_warrior: an ORIGINAL Cheoyong-inspired warrior: a mask-folk spirit with an original ruddy wooden mask with calm eyes and a flower-topped hat, dancing sleeves, holding a small wooden club, mid-turn dance that confuses enemies.
mask_wizard: an ORIGINAL mask wizard: a small hooded mask-folk spirit with a smooth pale wooden mask painted with simple spiral eyes, hemp robe hung with tassels, holding a carved wooden wand topped with a small mask charm that glows dusky violet.
thunder_mask_warrior: an ORIGINAL thunder-mask warrior: a mask-folk spirit wearing a wooden mask with dokkaebi-like horns painted blue, hemp armor, swinging a bronze drum-club that throws small pale-gold lightning ribbons.
glacier_warrior: an ORIGINAL glacier warrior: a mask-folk spirit with a frost-white carved mask edged with ice, heavy quilted coat, wielding a long wooden pole-axe crusted with ice, frost mist at its feet.
great_mask_god: an ORIGINAL great mask god: a tall mask-folk deity with a large carved wooden mask of a benevolent laughing elder, layered festival robes with many tassels, arms raised wide to bless allies, small drum hanging at the hip.
mask_complete: an ORIGINAL mask sovereign: a monumental mask-folk spirit wearing a grand carved lacquered mask with a serene expression, festival robes with long hanging tassels, surrounded by three small floating wooden masks; open blessing stance.
celestial_dancer: an ORIGINAL moon dancer: an upright white RABBIT CREATURE in a flowing pale silver dance robe with moon-thread sash, spinning with a long ribbon that forms a crescent arc; graceful and calm.
three_legged_crow: an ORIGINAL three-legged crow (samjogo): a sleek black crow creature with THREE clearly visible legs, perched upright with wings half spread before a sun-brass disk, loosing a straight beam-arrow of ivory-gold light from its open beak toward the front. Folk-painting inspired; reads as ranged.
storm_archer: an ORIGINAL moonlight storm archer: an upright silver-grey RABBIT CREATURE with a crescent-shaped bow, drawing an arrow crackling with pale-gold lightning, moon-thread scarf whipping in the wind.
moonlight_rabbit: an ORIGINAL moonlight rabbit: a round soft white RABBIT CREATURE with long ears and a small crescent moon charm, holding a tiny mortar of glowing rice cake that heals, open-armed gentle stance.
starlight_fairy: an ORIGINAL starlight fairy: a small upright white RABBIT CREATURE with translucent moon-thread shawl dotted with tiny star lights, holding a little lantern shaped like a star, floating slightly; cheerful.
crescent_archer: an ORIGINAL crescent archer: an upright dusky-furred RABBIT CREATURE with long ears, drawing a bow shaped like a crescent moon, arrow of silver moonlight; focused ranged stance.
moonlight_tiger: an ORIGINAL moonlight tiger: an upright pale silver TIGER CREATURE with faint grey stripes and frost breath, crouched to pounce, a moon-thread collar with a small silver crescent charm.
galaxy_warrior: an ORIGINAL galaxy warrior: an upright deep-indigo TIGER CREATURE whose stripes shimmer like faint star dust, wearing silver moon-thread armor, swinging a curved moon-silver blade.
full_moon_sorcerer: an ORIGINAL full-moon sorcerer: an old upright white RABBIT CREATURE with a long silver beard, a round full-moon disk hovering behind it, holding a staff topped with a crescent; serene magic pose.
solar_eclipse_warrior: an ORIGINAL solar eclipse warrior: an upright dark TIGER CREATURE with a sun-brass ring eclipsed behind it, agile evasive pose, short twin silver claws, dusky crescent-shaped cape.
lunar_eclipse_mage: an ORIGINAL lunar eclipse mage: an upright dusky-violet RABBIT CREATURE in a dark hooded robe, holding up a small dark moon orb with a thin silver crescent edge, casting a curse glow.
moonlight_complete: an ORIGINAL moon sovereign: a monumental white TIGER and RABBIT pair motif — a large calm white tiger with a small rabbit sage riding on its back under a great silver crescent, moon threads flowing; majestic, clear silhouette.
mountain_god: an ORIGINAL dragon-mountain deity: a serene coiled wingless Korean dragon with a long crest, celadon scales and cloud-braid whiskers, coiled around a small peak-shaped stone, holding a glowing pearl in blessing. Not Chinese imperial.
red_dragon_warrior: an ORIGINAL red dragon warrior: an upright compact dragon-kin creature with crimson scales, a long crest and short tail, weathered bronze armor pieces, wielding a heavy glaive with ember glints; furious stance.
blue_dragon_guardian: an ORIGINAL blue dragon guardian: an upright sturdy dragon-kin creature with celadon-blue scales and a long crest, holding a great round bronze shield shaped like a coiled dragon, frost breath; protective stance.
gold_dragon_sage: an ORIGINAL yellow dragon sage: an old coiled wingless dragon with ochre-gold scales, long white whiskers and cloud-braid beard, holding a scroll case and a small sack of brass coins; wise gentle expression.
black_dragon_assassin: an ORIGINAL black dragon assassin: a lean upright dragon-kin creature with black scales and a slim crest, wrapped in ink cloth, crouched with a short curved blade, half-fading into dark mist.
white_dragon_healer: an ORIGINAL white dragon healer: a gentle coiled wingless dragon with pearl-white scales and a soft crest, cradling a healing pearl that glows ivory-gold, cloud braid trailing; sheltering coil.
blue_dragon_archmage: an ORIGINAL blue dragon archmage: a majestic coiled wingless dragon with deep celadon scales and a long crest, floating in a cloud braid, lightning crackling between its claws around a pearl.
banya_guardian: an ORIGINAL Banya guardian: a fierce dragon-kin temple guardian with red-bronze scales and a flame-shaped crest, weathered bronze armor, holding a vajra-like bronze club; ember aura, monumental stance. Not a copy of any specific temple statue.
dragon_avatar: an ORIGINAL dragon avatar: a radiant coiled wingless Korean dragon of ember-red and bronze scales rising in a spiral, holding a flaming pearl, cloud braid swirling; legendary presence, clean silhouette.
twilight_dragon: an ORIGINAL twilight dragon: a coiled wingless dragon with scales fading from dusky violet to deep indigo, a long crest, breathing a line of violet mist forward.
five_dragon_complete: an ORIGINAL five-dragon sovereign: one majestic coiled wingless Korean dragon with celadon scales and a long crest, wrapped in a flowing five-colored cloud braid in muted red, blue, white, black and ochre, holding a luminous pearl aloft; monumental and calm.
celestial_guardian: an ORIGINAL celestial guardian: a tall airy spirit knight in pale cloud-sleeve armor with a tall sun-brass crest crown, holding a long pale spear and small round sun-brass shield; noble protective stance.
sky_archer: an ORIGINAL sky archer: a light airy spirit in pale cloud-sleeve robes with a tall feathered crown, drawing a long white bow whose arrow trails cloud braid; reads as ranged.
heaven_mage: an ORIGINAL heaven mage: a slender spirit in pale layered robes with long cloud sleeves and a tall sun-brass crown, holding a staff topped with a small sun disk crackling with pale-gold lightning.
solar_warrior: an ORIGINAL solar warrior: a sturdy spirit in sun-brass armor with a radiant tall crest, wielding a broad blade glowing with ember light, cloud-sleeve cape; bold stance.
divine_healer: an ORIGINAL divine healer: a gentle spirit in flowing pale cloud-sleeve robes, tall airy crown, holding a small sun-brass bowl of glowing water, arms opened in blessing.
starlight_knight: an ORIGINAL starlight knight: an agile spirit in pale silver armor with star-shaped studs and a tall crown crest, twin slim swords crackling with pale-gold light, double-strike pose.
celestial_sage: an ORIGINAL celestial sage: an old serene spirit with a long white beard, tall airy crown, pale cloud-sleeve robes, holding a sun-brass mirror that casts a straight beam of light.
god_realm_general: an ORIGINAL god-realm general: a monumental spirit commander in sun-brass lamellar armor with cloud-sleeve cape and a tall winged crest helmet, holding a great halberd and command banner; commanding stance.
empyrean_sovereign: an ORIGINAL empyrean sovereign: a majestic tall spirit ruler in layered pale and sun-brass robes with enormous cloud sleeves, a tall airy crown with a sun disk, raising one hand in command, calm radiant face.
abyssal_seer: an ORIGINAL abyssal seer: a hunched ancient stone-and-root creature with one large glowing eye in a cracked relic-stone face, roots trailing like a robe, holding a staff of petrified wood; supportive calm.
chaos_reaver: an ORIGINAL chaos reaver: an asymmetrical beast of cracked stone plates and ember seams, one arm a huge stone blade, the other small, lunging in an evasive sidestep.
void_harbinger: an ORIGINAL harbinger: a tall lopsided stone-and-root figure with a cracked relic mask, hurling a spear of dark crystal from an elongated arm; reads as ranged.
primordial_shaman: an ORIGINAL primordial shaman: a squat root-covered stone creature with ember seams, holding a crooked staff of fossil wood crackling with pale-gold lightning, beads of old stone around the neck.
